china-1919:p0741_1.rationale: Revised import tariff schedule for cotton goods with agreed values and proposed duty rates per unit; subject is import duties on mainly cotton articles.

china-1919:p0742_1.rationale: Proposed import duty schedule for printed and yarn-dyed cotton piece goods and cotton manufactures, with agreed values and duty rates.

china-1919:p0743_1.rationale: Multi-page import tariff covering handkerchiefs, cotton, flax and hemp, silk, wool goods and metals; mixed textile emphasis, with duty rates and agreed values.

china-1919:p0746_1.rationale: Import tariff values and proposed duty rates for copper articles and iron and steel products.

china-1919:p0747_1.rationale: Import tariff schedule for various metals (galvanized iron, lead, tin, zinc, nickel and others); too many metals for a few specific tags.

china-1919:p0747_2.rationale: Import tariff values and duty rates for fishery and sea products such as agar, bicho de mar and dried fish; no tag covers imported fishery goods specifically.
review_questions: Is a tag for fishery products trade needed?

china-1919:p0748_1.rationale: Import tariff on fish products, canned goods, groceries, spices, sugar, wines and spirits with agreed values and duty rates; a broad commodity mix.

china-1919:p0752_1.rationale: Import tariff covering spirits, tobacco, chemicals, dyes and pigments with agreed values and duty rates; a broad mix of commodities.

china-1919:p0754_1.rationale: Import tariff for candles, gums, oils, soap, paper, hides, furs and animal substances with agreed values and duty rates; a broad mix of commodities.

china-1919:p0757_1.rationale: Import tariff values and proposed duty rates for animal-derived articles such as feathers, hair, horns, musk and sinews.
